items.title: Jamey Aebersold interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 26, 2022
items.q: Gee. I listened to Ted Nash.

ctx.x: What were the saxophone players that you aspired to sound like, or isn’t that a relevant question for you?
Oh no, that’s highly relevant. Gee. I listened to Ted Nash. Do you remember Ted Nash?
